cells.name: brilliant
cells.species: a round brilliant: a faceted gem lathed from a cut profile, split into R, G, B at the exit

cells.name: prism_bar
cells.species: an n-sided glass bar: a regular polygon extruded, strong dispersion throws spectra

cells.name: ring_torus
cells.species: a rounded torus of colored glass; the tone swatch sets the dye

cells.name: soft_cube
cells.species: a superellipsoid cube in aqua glass: |x|^e + |y|^e + |z|^e = 1

cells.name: glass_glyph
cells.species: a glass letter S: two Quilez arcs extruded and rounded, in amber

cells.name: morph_solid
cells.species: polished steel looping cube → sphere → octahedron → torus by blending distances
eq: d = mix(shapeᵢ, shapeᵢ₊₁, smoothstep(0.2, 0.8, fract s))

cells.name: cube_jack
cells.species: seven rounded gold cubes in a 3D plus, breathing apart and together

cells.name: chamfer_dodeca
cells.species: a hammered copper dodecahedron, its twenty corners cut by the vertex planes

cells.name: gyroid_core
cells.species: a steel sphere carved to a gyroid sheet, a hot core glowing through the channels

cells.name: bead_chain
cells.species: candy beads on a helix spring; smooth-min necks form and snap as k breathes

cells.name: lava_lamp
cells.species: wax rising and merging by smooth-min inside a tapered glass vessel, glowing hot at the base
eq: wax d = smin over 5 balls of r = 0.14 + 0.05 sin 2.3i,  k = 0.24
sphere trace: t += d(ro + t·rd),  hit at d < 0.0008t

cells.name: oil_drops
cells.species: five amber oil drops orbiting and fusing by smooth-min, lit through their bodies
eq: d = smin over 5 drops, r = 0.36 − 0.04i,  k = 0.1…0.45 (fusion)
dispersive glass: η − s, η, η + s for R, G, B

cells.name: mercury
cells.species: a liquid-metal blob wobbling in its own pool while two drops bounce and rejoin
eq: sphere trace: t += d(ro + t·rd),  hit at d < 0.0008t

cells.name: soap_bubble
cells.species: a soap bubble: film thickness swirls and drains, both walls interfere
eq: film: I = ½ + ½ cos(2π·2η·h·cos θₜ/λ + π),  λ = 650, 532, 450

cells.name: iris_blob
cells.species: a tumbling noise-warped blob under a fixed film: the hue follows the view angle
eq: film: I = ½ + ½ cos(2π·2η·h·cos θₜ/λ + π),  λ = 650, 532, 450

cells.name: oil_slick
cells.species: a black glass sphere wearing an oil film that flows in contour bands

cells.name: nacre
cells.species: a baroque pearl: soft body light plus pastel orient from thin nacre platelets

cells.name: ink_block
cells.species: two dyes domain-warped through a glass block, marched in 24 steps

cells.name: cat_eye
cells.species: a glass marble with three twisted color vanes, traced as a solid inside the sphere

cells.name: nebula_orb
cells.species: an emission nebula and a star field held inside a clear glass orb
eq: refract in at η = 1.45,  24 steps through the orb

cells.name: rainbow_knot
cells.species: a torus-knot filament of light; the hue runs along the curve and loops
eq: core at (0.6 + 0.3 cos Qs,  0.3 sin Qs),  Q = 3, 5, 7

cells.name: granule_star
cells.species: a star with Worley granulation, limb darkening and a warped corona gathered along the ray

cells.name: plasma_ring
cells.species: a wireframe sphere drawn only near its silhouette, ringed by a flickering plasma
eq: ring = e^(−|b − R|/w),  b = ray distance from the center,  R = 0.85

cells.name: neon_shell
cells.species: a warped sphere shell with no surface, only glow gathered where the ray grazes it

cells.name: box_frame
cells.species: a brass box frame (Quilez sdBoxFrame) caging a glowing cube that turns against it

cells.name: hex_nut
cells.species: a chamfered hex nut (Quilez sdHexPrism) climbing a threaded rod in step with the helix

cells.name: chain_link
cells.species: four interlocked chain links (Quilez sdLink), gold and gunmetal by turns, swinging

cells.name: octa_lacquer
cells.species: an exact octahedron (Quilez) in vermilion lacquer with gold inlay along its edges

cells.name: cone_lamp
cells.species: a table lamp: a capped-cone shade lit from inside, a rounded-cylinder base (Quilez)

cells.name: dish_moon
cells.species: a panelled moon with a dish bitten out of it (Quilez death-star distance), lit on its night side

cells.name: sector_scoop
cells.species: a Quilez solid angle opening from a waffle cone to a bitten sphere, its cap glazed

cells.name: pyramid_strata
cells.species: a Quilez pyramid laid in sandstone courses with a gold capstone, on the studio floor

cells.name: smooth_union
cells.species: smooth-min against plain min: a sphere and a box fuse, the neck takes both colors; ghosts show the operands

cells.name: smooth_carve
cells.species: smooth subtraction: an orbiting ghost sphere scoops a layered block and shows its strata

cells.name: intersect_lens
cells.species: intersection: a cube and a breathing sphere keep only what both hold; the sphere parts turn gold

cells.name: onion_cutaway
cells.species: the onion operator: a rounded block grown into nested shells, a sliding wedge cut opens them

cells.name: twist_bar
cells.species: the twist operator: a striped square bar wrung about its axis, the straight bar as a ghost

cells.name: bend_plank
cells.species: the bend operator: graph paper on a plank curls and flattens; the flat plank stays as a ghost

cells.name: repeat_grid
cells.species: finite repetition: a lattice of beveled cubes grows and shrinks ring by ring, colored by cell id

cells.name: elongate_round
cells.species: elongation and rounding: an octahedron stretched along x and z, the inserted slab striped

cells.name: displace_wave
cells.species: displacement: a sphere plus a product of sines, peaks warm and troughs cool; the plain sphere ghosts

cells.name: jade_bi
cells.species: a jade bi disc with a raised grain pattern: light crosses the stone and comes out green

cells.name: wax_candle
cells.species: a pillar candle with drips; the flame lights the wax from inside and the room from above

cells.name: crackle_vase
cells.species: a celadon vase with two crackle networks in its glaze: dark iron lines and fine gold threads

cells.name: velvet_cushion
cells.species: a tufted velvet cushion with piping and gold tassels: dark at the face, bright sheen at the edge

cells.name: brushed_knob
cells.species: a brushed aluminium knob: seven tilted reflection samples streak the light round its face

cells.name: carbon_egg
cells.species: a carbon-fibre egg: a 2x2 twill of fibre tows, each lit along its own grain, under a clear coat

cells.name: turned_bowl
cells.species: a turned wooden bowl: growth rings from a log axis cut across, pores, an oiled sheen

cells.name: marble_pair
cells.species: a green marble sphere resting on a white marble block, veins by turbulence, polished

cells.name: ebony_pawn
cells.species: a lathed pawn in ebony lacquer stepping one square on a board, its profile built from 2D shapes

cells.name: ivory_rook
cells.species: a lathed rook in ivory with a crenellated crown cut by a six-fold angular fold

cells.name: wine_glass
cells.species: a thin-walled wine glass with sloshing red wine: each wall refracts in and out, the wine absorbs
eq: light refracts in and out of each wall,  the wine absorbs

cells.name: hourglass
cells.species: an hourglass in a walnut and brass frame; the sand drains as a funnel and builds a cone below
eq: top sand level = mix(0.62, 0.04, f),  bottom cone = mix(−0.78, −0.24, √f)
two ellipsoid bulbs (0.4, 0.38, 0.4) joined by smin 0.1

cells.name: teacup
cells.species: a porcelain teacup and saucer, gold rims and a cobalt band, tea inside and steam rising
eq: lathe profile: segments in (r, y) around the y axis
tea level y = 0,  steam: three fbm wisps over 12 steps

cells.name: bowling_pin
cells.species: a bowling pin rocking on its base beside a marbled ball; pin from blended ellipsoid, capsule and sphere

cells.name: spinning_top
cells.species: a lacquered spinning top: it spins, precesses and nutates on its tip, a painted spiral on its crown

cells.name: borromean
cells.species: Borromean rings: three stadium rings (elongated tori) in gold, silver and copper; no two link
eq: ring = |(|e_xz| − 0.3, e_y)| − r,  e = q − clamp(q_x, −h, h)x̂
three rings in the xz, yx and zy planes

cells.name: gear_train
cells.species: three spur gears of 14, 9 and 7 teeth on a plate; each turns at the ratio of its tooth count

cells.name: ball_bearing
cells.species: a deep-groove ball bearing: ten balls in a brass cage roll between turning races
eq: 10 balls r = 0.12 in a groove of radius 0.128 at r = 0.62
shaft key turns at ω = (0.3…2)·t,  balls and cage at 0.4ω
races: inner at r = 0.45,  outer at r = 0.85

cells.name: newton_cradle
cells.species: a Newton cradle of five chrome balls on V-strings; the end balls swing and pass the knock along

cells.name: gimbal
cells.species: a three-axis gimbal with degree ticks round each ring and a flywheel spinning at the centre

cells.name: puzzle_cube
cells.species: a three-by-three twisting puzzle cube: limited repetition per layer, one layer turning

cells.name: menger_sponge
cells.species: a level-three Menger sponge in porcelain, its tunnels glowing deeper the further in they run

cells.name: sierpinski_tet
cells.species: a Sierpinski tetrahedron by six reflective folds, in iridescent bismuth

cells.name: mandelbox_slice
cells.species: a slab cut from a Mandelbox: box fold, sphere fold, scale; chalk white with an orange orbit trap

cells.name: quat_julia
cells.species: a quaternion Julia set sliced into 3D, its constant orbiting; colored by the orbit trap

cells.name: apollonian
cells.species: an Apollonian packing by repeated sphere inversion, cut by a sphere like a geode

cells.name: kifs_crystal
cells.species: a quartz cluster folded kaleidoscopically: a five-fold and a mirror fold place hexagonal points, in dispersive glass

cells.name: gyroid_lattice
cells.species: a graded gyroid shell lattice in a rounded cube: thin at the top, dense at the base, matte nylon

cells.name: nautilus
cells.species: a nautilus shell on a logarithmic spiral, a quarter cut away to show the chambers and septa in nacre

cells.name: coral_branch
cells.species: branching coral grown by mirror folds: each step folds, turns, tilts and shrinks, swaying in a current

cells.name: glow_mushrooms
cells.species: five mushrooms on a mossy mound: tan caps with pale spots, gills glowing with bioluminescence

cells.name: pine_cone
cells.species: a pine cone: scales placed by the golden angle, found through the 8 and 13 parastichy lattice

cells.name: melt_drip
cells.species: chocolate melting off a truffle on a plaster pedestal: drips stretch, bead and fall into a pool

cells.name: glass_on_granite
cells.species: a glass sphere on polished black granite: it focuses the key light to a caustic in its shadow

cells.name: pebble_cairn
cells.species: a cairn of five river pebbles in basalt, granite, quartz, jasper and serpentine, wet and gently rocking

cells.name: floating_island
cells.species: a floating island: grass on a cone of layered rock, one tree, a waterfall pouring off the edge

cells.name: colonnade
cells.species: an endless colonnade by domain repetition, walked through at dusk with soft column shadows and fog
